selection_rationale.title: Unique Properties of NMDA Receptors Enhance Synaptic Excitation of Radiatum Giant Cells in Rat Hippocampus
selection_rationale.reason: HIGH node_relevance across 8 abstract/body snippets and MODERATE across 7 more; foundational Kirson & Yaari paper (PMID:10864941) cited in NODE CONTEXT. Provides direct quotes on RGC morphology (large triangular soma in stratum radiatum, two apical dendrites, axon projecting to subiculum and fimbria, three morphological subtypes), electrophysiology (NMDA receptor-dependent burst firing, larger EPSCs, reduced Mg2+ sensitivity, slower decay kinetics), and proposed molecular basis (NR2D subunit candidate). Traversing its references at depth 1 will surface upstream sources (Gulyas et al. 1998 RGC projection neuron, Maccaferri & McBain 1996 spike ADP, Monyer et al. 1994 NR2 subunit biophysics) that are likely to yield further marker, anatomy, and morphology evidence.
